tools.name: start_here
tools.description: Orientation for this corpus right now — which regulations are loaded, unit counts, data_as_of, what is not held, and first-call hints per module. Built from the loaded corpus at call time. Cheap: one call, no quota. Then list_regulations, search_regulation, or list_workflows.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Who is calling: tier, trial state, corpus load count. Pass trial_id from connect() to confirm the handle used for assessments and private workflows. After connect, call start_here or list_regulations.

tools.name: record_assessment
tools.description: Record one structured applicability verdict on a regulation pinpoint for this keyless trial_id (from connect). Verdicts: applicable | not_applicable | needs_review | deferred. Optional reason codes only — never free-text notes. Re-recording the same regulation+pinpoint overwrites. Assessments annota

tools.name: list_assessments
tools.description: List this trial_id's recorded assessments, newest first. Pass the trial_id from connect(). Use when resuming a multi-week DPIA or applicability review. Never invent rows for another trial.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description:
Send feedback about Rekvira to the team that builds it: a bug, a wrong answer, missing data, a missing feature, a workflow idea, or praise. Every item is read by a person.

tools.name: list_regulations
tools.description: List regulations in the registry and whether corpus JSON is loaded. Then search_regulation, search_regulations, or list_workflows for a named process.

tools.name: search_regulation
tools.description: Search held regulation text. Returns pinpoints and excerpts, not summaries. Requires regulation id (e.g. eu-ai-act) and query string. limit, detail (compact|full) and max_chars bound the response. Then read_unit on the best pinpoints; verify_citation if checking someone else's cite.

tools.name: search_regulations
tools.description: Search all loaded regulation modules in one call, ranked by relevance across them. Use when the question names more than one act or you do not know which act holds the answer. limit, detail (compact|full) and max_chars bound the response; per_regulation_min gives each act a share of the page. tools.name: verify_citation
tools.description: Verify a citation someone else produced — does the pinpoint exist in held text, and optionally does the quote appear. Pass the cite as written (e.g. 'Article 6(1) EU AI Act') plus optional quote=. Then read_unit for full text. regulation= disambiguates when the cite omits the act name; returns regul

tools.name: read_unit
tools.description: Read one citable unit by kind and number or label. Articles return aggregated paragraph text. Paragraphs repeat across articles — pass article= (e.g. 6 or '6') to disambiguate. number, label and article accept JSON numbers or strings. read_unit also takes a result row's pinpoint verbatim: pinpoint='

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Playbook library for compliance-officer workflows — high-risk triage, DORA ICT review, cross-reg scans, vendor questionnaires. Read a playbook before improvising a process. Pass trial_id from connect to list your own private drafts beside the shipped library. Then call get_workflow with workflow_id

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.description: Full step-by-step playbook for one workflow id from list_workflows. Follow the named tools (search_regulation, read_unit, verify_citation, …) rather than summarising the playbook.

tools.name: save_workflow
tools.description: Save or update one private compliance playbook for this keyless trial. It stays inside this trial_id; call publish_workflow only to mark it ready here, never to share it with another user.

tools.name: publish_workflow
tools.description: Mark one of this trial_id private playbooks ready or draft. Publishing is private state only; it never adds content to the shipped library or another trial.

tools.name: delete_workflow
tools.description: Delete one private workflow for this trial_id. It cannot delete a shipped playbook or a draft owned by another trial.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "lookup_obligations" is 1736 chars, far longer than this server's median (315). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rekvira_account, list_assessments, list_workflows · Private data: connect, rekvira_account, whoami, record_assessment, list_workflows, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, rekvira_account, submit_feedback, search_regulations, save_workflow, publish_workflow · Destructive: rekvira_account, delete_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rekvira_account, list_assessments, list_workflows · Private data: connect, rekvira_account, whoami, record_assessment, list_workflows, save_workflow, publish_workflow, delete_workflow · Public sink: connect, connect_verify, rekvira_account, submit_feedback, search_regulations, save_workflow, publish_workflow · Destructive: rekvira_account, delete_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
